data.formalCheck: h is the family of closed neighborhoods. The family intersection operation is pairwise set intersection, so wp sqcap h is exactly the targets contained in some closed neighborhood. Pairwise family union extends targets dominated by chosen subsets. The textual negation contradicts this.
